title: AI Campaign Production
description: AI-assisted campaign production across CMS, DAM and Jira workflows.

revisions.name: Stable Campaign Production baseline
revisions.summary: Imported the stable V0/Cursor Campaign Production prototype into Design Studio as the accepted baseline.
revisions.scope: Initial accepted baseline. No product or interaction redesign was introduced during the Studio import.
preserve: Full Campaigns table → select row → in-situ split view → inspect → close → restore full table.
Campaign Production remains a control layer and wayfinder over CMS, DAM and Jira rather than replacing those systems.
Attention states are actionable and resolving an item updates surrounding workflow state.
Human checkpoints remain visible around consequential or uncertain automated steps.

validation.notes: Stable imported baseline verified through its independent Vercel deployment and Studio route.

revisions.name: Baseline interaction cleanup
revisions.summary: Baseline interaction cleanup: centre the Attention counter in a square badge, implement Find destination as Content item → unpopulated image chooser, and standardise campaign actions to a single ghost icon or ellipsis menu.
revisions.scope: Three tightly scoped interaction fixes. (1) Attention nav counter: flex-centred, approximately square, 4px radius, horizontal growth for larger values. (2) Find destination: staged popover selecting campaign content then an unpopulated image-chooser field by visible title; linking updates the existing content/asset graph. (3) Campaign actions: Archive ghost icon for Needs attention and Needs review; Duplicate + Archive overflow menu for Signed off.
